doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Submission of the Veterinary Surgeons and Practitioners (Infamous Conduct) Regulations, No.1 of 2025, to Parliament for approval
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - The Veterinary Surgeons and Practitioners Act, No.46 of 1956 was introduced with a view to establishing a legal framework for the registration of veterinary surgeons and practitioners in Sri Lanka, defining their professional qualifications, and establishing the Sri Lanka Veterinary Council to regulate the veterinary profession. The Regulations published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2470/12 dated 2026-01-05, have been made with the objective of empowering the Sri Lanka Veterinary Council to define professional misconduct including acts or omissions constituting misuse of position falling under the category of 'Infamous Conduct'; establish a mechanism for appointing 'Inquiry Boards' to investigate such conduct; and impose penalties on offenders, including temporary suspension of registration, cancellation of registration and issuance of warnings. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land, and Irrigation to present the 'Veterinary Surgeons and Practitioners (Infamous Conduct) Regulations, No.1 of 2025 so published, to Parliament for approval.
